segments.text:
In the beginning God made all things very good, created man after his own Image and likeneſſe, filling him with all perfection of all naturall excellency and uprightneſſe, free from all ſinne. But long he abode not in this honour, but by the ſubtiltie of the Serpent, which Satan uſed as his inſtrument, himſelfe with his Angels having ſinned before, and not kept their firſt eſtate, but left their owne habitation; firſt
Eve, then Adam being ſeduced did wittingly and willingly fall into diſobedience and tranſgreſſion of the Commandement of their great Creator, for the which death came upon all, and reigned over all, ſo that all ſince the Fall are conceived in ſinne, and brought forth in iniquitie, and ſo by nature children of wrath, and ſervants of ſinne, ſubjects of death, and all
other calamities due to ſinne in this world and for ever, being conſidered in the ſtate of nature, without relation to Chriſt.
